description: Open backlog for autonomous Ralph loop execution. Edit this file to add/update items. Do not change status fields manually while a loop is running.

items.title: API returns 500 on missing optional query parameter
items.description: When the /api/search endpoint is called without the optional 'filter' query parameter, it throws an unhandled TypeError instead of returning results with no filter applied. Reproducible with: GET /api/search?q=test (omitting &filter=). Expected: returns results. Actual: 500 Internal Server Error.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/search?q=test returns 200 with unfiltered results when 'filter' param is absent
No unhandled TypeError in server logs on this request
Regression test added covering the missing-parameter case
npm test passes

items.title: Python data processor crashes on empty input file
items.description: data_processor.py raises IndexError when given an input CSV with no data rows (header only). The error occurs at line ~47 in the row iteration. Empty files are a valid input — they should produce empty output, not a crash.
acceptanceCriteria: data_processor.py handles empty CSV (header-only) without raising an exception
Output for empty input is an empty result set (not an error)
pytest test added: test_empty_input_returns_empty_result
pytest passes

items.title: Extract inline validation logic into dedicated validator module
items.description: Input validation is currently duplicated across 4–5 route handlers (email format check, required field checks, length limits). Extract into a shared validators.ts (or validators.py) module with reusable, tested functions. Do not change validation behavior — purely structural.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared validator module created with all extracted validation functions
All route handlers import from the new module — no inline duplicates remain
Existing behavior unchanged (no validation rules loosened or tightened)
Unit tests added for each validator function
All existing tests still pass after refactor
TypeScript: npm run typecheck passes with no new errors

items.title: Replace console.log debug statements with structured logger
items.description: The codebase has ~20 ad-hoc console.log() calls used for debugging. Replace with the existing logger utility (src/lib/logger.ts) using appropriate log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Remove any logs that were clearly temporary debug prints. Keep any that represent meaningful application events.
acceptanceCriteria: No bare console.log() calls remain in src/ (console.error in catch blocks is acceptable)
Replaced logs use logger.debug() or logger.info() with meaningful messages
Obvious temporary debug logs removed entirely
Application behavior unchanged
npm test passes

items.title: Add pagination to the /api/items list endpoint
items.description: The /api/items endpoint currently returns all records with no limit, which will become a performance problem as data grows. Add cursor-based pagination using 'limit' and 'cursor' query params. Default limit: 50. Max limit: 200. Response should include a 'nextCursor' field (null if no more pages).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/items?limit=10 returns exactly 10 items and a nextCursor value
GET /api/items?limit=10&cursor=<nextCursor> returns the next page
GET /api/items returns default 50 items when no limit specified
limit > 200 is rejected with 400 Bad Request
nextCursor is null when on the last page
Response schema: { items: [...], nextCursor: string | null, total: number }
Tests cover: default page, explicit limit, cursor navigation, limit exceeded, last page
TypeScript types updated for new response shape
npm test and npm run typecheck pass

items.title: Add Python CLI flag for dry-run mode
items.description: The main.py script currently writes output files on every run. Add a --dry-run flag that runs all processing but writes nothing to disk, printing a summary of what would have been written instead. Useful for validation without side effects.
acceptanceCriteria: python main.py --dry-run processes input without writing any output files
Dry-run mode prints a summary: 'Would write: <filename> (<N> records)'  for each file that would have been created
Normal mode (no flag) behavior unchanged
--help output documents the --dry-run flag
pytest tests cover dry-run produces no files and prints expected summary
pytest passes

items.title: Update npm dependencies to latest minor/patch versions
items.description: Several npm packages are behind on minor and patch versions. Run npm outdated, update packages that have non-breaking minor/patch updates (skip major version bumps — those need separate review). Verify nothing breaks.
acceptanceCriteria: npm outdated shows no available minor/patch updates after update
No major version bumps applied (those stay for manual review)
npm test passes after updates
npm run typecheck passes after updates
package-lock.json committed alongside package.json changes
Any deprecation warnings noted in progress.md Codebase Patterns

items.title: Add missing docstrings to public Python functions
items.description: The Python modules are missing docstrings on most public functions, making the codebase harder to navigate. Add Google-style docstrings to all public functions (not private/underscore-prefixed) in the src/ directory. Do not change function signatures or behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All public functions in src/ have a Google-style docstring with Args and Returns sections
No function signatures changed
pytest passes (behavior unchanged)
If a function's purpose is unclear, add a TODO comment and move on — do not guess
